headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.21
summary: This release removes maesdk (Microsoft AppCenter telemetry) from 32-bit launches entirely: the v1.6.1-modder.20 test proved the game now starts, but AppCenter's telemetry init aborted the process because the launcher-bundled maesdk library doesn't match the Google Play game's Java. Since neither available arm32 maesdk binary works against a Play install, 32-bit launches now run without it and telemetry is disabled on those devices.

items.text: 32-bit testers: please install the armeabi-v7a APK from this release and launch several times in a row. The game reached its first black-screen start on v20 — this release removes the telemetry crash that stopped it from going further. Report whether Minecraft actually reaches the main menu.

Disabled the AppCenter (maesdk) telemetry path on 32-bit launches: v20 proved the game starts, but its telemetry initialization aborted the process with a JNI error because the bundled maesdk library was built against a different Java surface than the installed game's (the game's own maesdk binary crashes even earlier, as fixed around v19's SDK repository). On 32-bit devices maesdk is now excluded from loading and its dependency edge removed from the game library, so telemetry is simply off instead of fatal (issue #101).
